manifest.name: DocBlocks Documents
manifest.description: Create real documents from markdown — Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF, Excel (XLSX), EPUB, HTML, and MP4/GIF — via the DocBlocks MCP server. Artifact-first: conversions produce immutable session artifacts a gezel can inspect and preview page-by-page before saving the finished file into the project's artifacts drawer. Includes themes, slide templates, document validation, and PPTX layout inference.

tools.name: list_roots
tools.description: List the read/write filesystem root aliases granted to this session. Gezel grants the project workspace (read) and the project artifacts drawer (read + write) automatically.

tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: List live import/export format capabilities (md, docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx, csv, html, htmlzip, epub, dbk, mp4, gif) with supported fidelity per format.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List available visual theme IDs (documentary, cinematic, bold, ...).

tools.name: list_transform_styles
tools.description: List available content transform style IDs (magazine, data-driven, narrative, ...).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List slide/document template IDs and summaries.

tools.name: describe_template
tools.description: Describe a template's exact annotation syntax and required inputs.

tools.name: recommend_templates
tools.description: Profile a document's content blocks and recommend compatible templates.

tools.name: describe_theme
tools.description: Describe a built-in theme, or a custom theme embedded in a document source.

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Return bounded metadata, outline, block summaries, tables, assets, theme info, and diagnostics for a document source (markdown, file, artifact, or bundle).

tools.name: validate_document
tools.description: Validate a document's structure, assets, and accessibility metadata, with optional target-format fidelity checks before converting.

tools.name: compare_documents
tools.description: Compare semantic and structural retention between two document sources (round-trip regression checks).

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Convert one source (inline markdown, granted file, artifact, or bundle) into 1-12 immutable artifacts — DOCX, PPTX (slideBreak h1/h2), PDF, XLSX, CSV, HTML, EPUB, DBK, MP4, GIF — with optional theme, transform style, and auto-templates.

tools.name: create_document_bundle
tools.description: Package markdown plus explicit image/media assets into an immutable DBK bundle artifact so media travels with the document.

tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Render bounded, paginated preview images (up to 20 per call) of a document, deck, or sheet for visual review before saving.

tools.name: infer_theme_from_file
tools.description: Infer reusable theme colors/typography (and optionally Office layouts) from an existing DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX file.

tools.name: inspect_pptx_layouts
tools.description: Inspect a PPTX's slide size, masters, layouts, usage, and template mapping.

tools.name: apply_inferred_theme
tools.description: Apply an inferred theme/layout set to a document and return a new DBK artifact without mutating the source.

tools.name: save_artifact
tools.description: Persist one conversion artifact to a granted write root (the project's artifacts drawer) with no-replace or hash-conditional replacement semantics. The only tool that writes durable files.

tools.name: get_conversion_report
tools.description: Retrieve the stored provenance/diagnostics report for a conversion-backed artifact.
